author: Nicole Kennedy
title: Apple (AAPL) Price Target Lowered to $168.00 at Barclays
text:
Tweet 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price decreased by Barclays from $170.00 to $168.00 in a research note released on Friday, MarketBeat reports. Barclays currently has an equal weight rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
A number of other research analysts also recently issued reports on the company. Royal Bank of Canada restated a buy rating and set a $205.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 9th. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a research note on Wednesday, March 7th. Vetr downgraded Apple from a buy rating to a hold rating and set a $183.68 target price on the stock. in a research note on Tuesday, March 6th. ValuEngine upgraded Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating in a research note on Thursday, March 1st. Finally, BidaskClub upgraded Apple from a sell rating to a hold rating in a research note on Saturday, February 17th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of Buy and a consensus target price of $201.53. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple stock opened at $175.30 on Friday. The stock has a market capitalization of $903,275.88, a P/E ratio of 18.02, a P/E/G ratio of 1.34 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. Apple has a 12 month low of $138.62 and a 12 month high of $183.50. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $3.36 EPS. analysts expect that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is owned by insiders. 
Several large investors have recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. BlackRock Inc. grew its position in Apple by 1.0% during the fourth quarter. BlackRock Inc. now owns 319,715,585 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $54,105,468,000 after acquiring an additional 3,048,055 shares during the period. Berkshire Hathaway Inc. grew its position in Apple by 0.6% during the second quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc. now owns 130,191,960 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $18,750,246,000 after acquiring an additional 834,854 shares during the period. Geode Capital Management LLC grew its position in Apple by 2.5% during the fourth quarter. Geode Capital Management LLC now owns 56,447,158 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,533,267,000 after acquiring an additional 1,356,879 shares during the period. Bank of New York Mellon Corp grew its position in Apple by 0.7% during the fourth quarter. Bank of New York Mellon Corp now owns 53,301,694 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,020,245,000 after acquiring an additional 360,312 shares during the period. Finally, Capital Research Global Investors grew its position in Apple by 15.0% during the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,241,383,000 after acquiring an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. 61.33% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
